Then after receiving the result, we call office_designer_design. But we can't do that in a single response. We need to do two separate interactions. So we need to call house first. Then after receiving the result, we call office. So we need to produce a response that calls house_designer_design. Then after receiving the result, we call office_designer_design. So we need to produce two separate responses. The first will call house_designer_design. Then we wait for the tool's result. Then we call office_designer_design.
